saw_lines: Curly hair buyers judge a product on hold and frizz after one wash, then reorder the same gel without rereading anything.
So the sale is won in the ad, when the first line names the hold and the offer, before anyone clicks through.
Your site shows two proof numbers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either one. Put one number on the creative and in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows two proof numbers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either one, so cold viewers get no scale signal. Put one number on the creative and in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 10% off the first order, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it. A first-time buyer has no reason to act today. Put that discount in line one of three new ads, and on the creative.

Your site runs subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, so repeat buyers get no reason to set up a routine. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at past buyers.
Your site lists prices at $6, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so a shopper cannot judge the cost before the click. Lead one ad with the price per pack, and one with the starter pack price.
